company.name: Carly
company.shortDescription: Saudi online marketplace for buying and selling new and used cars. Covers inspection, financing, and doorstep delivery across Saudi Arabia.
company.description:
Carly operating under the brand HalaCarly  is a Saudi Arabian e-commerce company that operates an online marketplace for buying and selling new and used cars. Founded in 2021 by Faisal Raza Khan and Yousef Al-Houkail and based in Riyadh, the company digitizes the entire vehicle transaction journey that traditionally required visiting physical showrooms.

Through its website and mobile apps (iOS and Android), Carly lets users browse vehicles with detailed filters, review transparent pricing, and complete purchases electronically. Each vehicle undergoes a 150-point inspection, and buyers are supported by a warranty of up to 12 months, a 7-day return policy, and flexible financing options arranged through licensed partners, including Buy-Now-Pay-Later via Tamara. Inspected vehicles are delivered to the customer's doorstep across major Saudi cities such as Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and Qassim, with coverage expanding nationwide.

In February 2021, Carly closed an angel investment round of SAR 3.75 million (approximately USD 1 million) to develop its technology, expand its team, and streamline customer procedures. The company's brand positioning is summarized in its tagline: "Click. Buy. Drive."
